_instructions: Copy this file to config.json, then replace the token below with your own. Get one at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens
_civitai_nsfw: Optional: true = include mature models in CivitAI search by default. Omit or false = the plugin behaves as before (SFW only).
_civitai_site: Optional: which CivitAI host the CivitAI tab starts on: 'civitai.com' (standard) or 'civitai.red' (adult front-end). Same catalogue either way; the host decides which download links get filled in.
_civitai_api_key: Optional: your CivitAI API key (civitai.com -> Account settings -> API Keys). Sent as Authorization: Bearer for searches and appended as ?token= to download URLs, which is what makes mature/auth-gated files downloadable and raises rate limits.
